leaf.identity: bareheaded cream-yellow cockatiel Leaf with swept cream and peach feather crest, plum explorer vest; squirrel vendor in purple hat behind the original four-petal seed wheel
leaf.focus: 모자 없이 씨앗 바퀴를 따라 몸을 기울이며 놀라는 리프
leaf.qa: 리프 머리에 모자 생성 금지. 회전축·손잡이 연결과 씨앗 바퀴 형태 유지.
leaf.outbound: A lively curious discovery, with clear movement of the whole upper body. The squirrel's paw already gripping the wooden crank turns it through ONE smooth full revolution around its fixed axle. Paw stays attached to the same knob, elbow bends naturally; the other paw braces the counter. The four existing seed petals rotate TOGETHER as one rigid wheel on its fixed central bearing, making one full revolution and returning to the same orientation. Seeds remain inside the shallow compartments. Leaf bends forward to inspect, then recoils with a delighted open-beak expression, lifting BOTH feathered wings slightly outward in surprise while following the wheel at table height. Leaf is ALWAYS BAREHEADED with only natural feathers: no cap, fabric, brim or strap can appear. End with the wheel still and Leaf brightly reacting, not frozen throughout.
leaf.return: Continue the lively reaction: bareheaded Leaf leans to the side to peer around the stationary seed wheel, looks toward the squirrel, and gives one delighted upper-body bounce with a small outward wing gesture. The squirrel smiles and nods while keeping the same crank knob and all four rigid seed petals stationary. Leaf then lowers both wings and returns the upper body, bare feathered head and gaze naturally to the exact reference pose. Feather crest stays attached and recognizable, no headwear at any time. Wheel, crank and counter remain solid and never morph.

tori.identity: brown beaver Tori wearing brass jeweler magnifying loupe strapped over viewer-right eye, cream sweater, navy apron; ONE screwdriver in viewer-right paw with tip already in the central screw of the solid clock housing
tori.focus: 돋보기로 나사를 가까이 살피고 드라이버로 정밀 조정하기
tori.qa: 돋보기의 눈과 나사 방향 일치. 렌즈를 작업물 가까이 가져가기. 드라이버·나사 접점과 두 앞발 유지.
tori.outbound: Make actual USE of the worn magnifying loupe the main readable action. Tori visibly bends the torso forward and lowers the head toward the central screw until the brass loupe is close to the work (about one loupe diameter above the screw), looking DOWN THROUGH that lens directly at the screw. Narrow the eye without a lens in concentration. Keep head pitched downward so the optical axis points to the screw, never toward the viewer. With the other paw bracing the rigid housing, rotate the existing screwdriver handle one small quarter turn while its metal tip stays engaged in the SAME screw slot. A substantial purposeful lean and careful wrist movement, not an idle nod. No new tool, floating gear, changing screw or extra paw. End close to the work, inspecting through the loupe.
tori.return: Still bent close to the screw, Tori shifts the head a few centimeters sideways to check the tiny adjustment through the worn loupe, keeping its optical axis aimed DOWN at the screw. Give a small pleased expression, then visibly straighten the torso and lift the head back to the exact starting position. The same screwdriver stays held in the same paw, tip engaged in the same fixed screw, and its handle eases back to the starting orientation with a precise wrist adjustment. Other paw keeps bracing. Lens, strap, two incisors, two paws, one tool and solid clock housing remain unchanged. No detached lens and no spontaneous clock movement.

block.identity: brown bear Block in ochre cape on left, smaller beaver Tori in lavender apron on right, single rigid wooden bridge with two arches and one brass marble
block.focus: 구슬을 굴려 다리를 시험하고 몸을 낮춰 따라보기
block.qa: 다리 크기·아치·구슬 개수 고정. 손과 몸의 움직임은 분명하게.
block.outbound: Energetic hands-on testing of their bridge. Block gives the single brass marble a definite push along the existing straight channel to the RIGHT with the paw already beside it, then pulls that paw clear. As it rolls, BOTH characters visibly bend their knees and lower their heads toward track height, tracking the rolling marble with their faces and eyes from left to right. Tori stops the marble at the right end gently with the nearest paw; no grasp or duplicate. They rise with a delighted broad grin and a small shoulder bounce of success. The entire bridge is ONE solid rigid object, fixed flat on table, exactly two arches and unchanging dimensions. No assembly, stretch, gaps or collapsing supports. Finish with the single marble resting right, characters delighted.
block.return: Tori pushes the SAME marble left along the fixed channel with the nearest paw and withdraws. Both characters dip their upper bodies forward to follow it, then Block gently stops it at its original left location with the original paw. Block and Tori exchange an animated happy glance and one small celebratory shoulder bounce, then restore their original upright poses and paws. This is actual rolling contact, no teleporting ball. The bridge remains absolutely unchanged with exactly two arches throughout; exactly one marble and four attached paws.

joy.identity: brown otter Joy in blue baker outfit at left, gray raccoon Mong in lavender at right; ONE finished white bunny pastry with two attached pink-centered ears on ivory plate
joy.focus: 토끼 빵에 가루를 뿌리고 손뼉 치며 기뻐하기
joy.qa: 토끼 귀는 처음부터 끝까지 두 개로 고정. 손에서 빵으로 가루가 떨어지는 연결, 앞발 네 개 유지.
joy.outbound: Active joyful baking performance. Joy pinches a little of the EXISTING flour on the counter with the visible nearest paw, raises that SAME paw above the finished bunny pastry and sprinkles a delicate small shower onto it. Follow the flour with eyes and a clear forward lean; keep the other paw on the plate rim. Mong leans in eagerly, then lifts both paws for ONE clear happy clap at chest height when the flour lands. Joy laughs with an open happy smile and bounces shoulders. The pastry is INANIMATE and holds its identical face, size and exactly TWO upright ears at all times: no shaping, kneading, added ears, living bunny or changing dough. Show obvious attached paw action, not only nods.
joy.return: Joy draws the sprinkling paw back and lightly dusts that paw against the other ONCE away from the pastry, making a tiny flour puff. Mong mirrors with one cheerful little shoulder bounce and lowers both paws onto their original table positions. Joy then lowers both paws to their exact original positions and leans back to the starting posture; smiles settle naturally. The finished bun never moves or changes shape, its TWO ears and face remain unchanged. Flour is subtle white dust only and settles naturally. End on the reference composition without dissolving or deforming the pastry.

pace.identity: small penguin Pace wearing brown embroidered traveling cape, pack and exactly TWO orange lace-up sneakers with cream soles, both securely attached to short legs
pace.focus: 출발 전 무릎을 굽혔다 펴며 날개를 크게 펴는 씩씩한 준비 동작
pace.qa: 주황 신발은 정확히 두 개. 발바닥은 원래 돌에 계속 닿고, 몸·날개·망토가 움직임.
pace.outbound: An energetic explorer warm-up, with substantial character movement, not an idle portrait. Both orange sneakers stay PLANTED at their exact reference footprints on the SAME starting stone for the whole shot. Pace bends both short knees into a clear small squat, lowers torso, then straightens enthusiastically and spreads BOTH flippers outward to balance, chest rising and cape responding naturally. Repeat one more cheerful knee bend and rise while looking toward the glowing next stone. Body visibly travels vertically and flippers swing outward then forward, but soles NEVER leave ground or slide. Exactly two securely worn orange shoes of fixed shape, count and size, never an extra shoe, bare foot, detached foot, step, jump or new limb. End upright with flippers open in an eager ready-to-go pose.
pace.return: Pace makes one lively shoulder-and-flipper stretch, extending both flippers out and then bringing them back toward the body, and gives one more clear small squat-and-rise with both soles staying flat at the SAME two original footprints. Cape sways with upper-body motion, not independently. Look from the next stone back to the initial gaze and settle both flippers and torso into the exact original pose. Exactly TWO intact orange lace-up sneakers remain planted and attached throughout; no walking, detached or spare shoe, exposed feet, turning, hopping or crossed legs. Keep substantial torso and flipper movement, not a frozen character.

explicitApproval.scope: Google Gemini reference-image transfer and 10 additional paid video requests; no automatic retries

toriImage.prompt: Edit this exact premium Tori collectible frame. Preserve the identical brown beaver face, cream muzzle, two incisors, swept hair, cream sweater, navy apron, leather head strap and brass jeweler magnifying loupe on viewer-right eye; preserve moonlit workshop, lighting, portrait 2:3, camera and tactile 3D craft quality. Change the WORK setup to a coherent precision inspection: replace the loose gear held by viewer-right paw with ONE short jeweler screwdriver held naturally by its wooden handle, metal tip pointed downward toward ONE large visible slotted adjustment screw at the center of a small solid brass clock housing on the table. Replace the exposed disconnected clock gears with a closed rigid navy/brass clock housing lying flat, about half the previous mechanism size, with that one adjustment screw on top. The other paw braces its left edge. Eliminate the hanging crescent apparatus completely, keeping the moon outside window. Tori's head is already angled slightly down toward the screw, eyes open and focused at the actual screw. Keep space to lean head and magnifying loupe close to the work. Exactly two paws, one screwdriver, one solid clock housing; believable physical contact. Lively engaged craftsman, not posing at camera. No text or new characters.
